title: Synthetic Realism in Finance: A High-Fidelity Market Simulation with Adaptive LLM Agents

contributions.mechanism: Brain-Memory架构:LLM'大脑'(Gemini 1.5 Pro)+文件持久记忆,单次仿真内检索过往经验并回写P&L
contributions.evaluation: 定性:LLMON表现出跨小时策略演化,LLMOFF/Baseline无(无量化指标)
contributions.source_quote: A Brain-Memory architecture that retrieves prior experiences and updates memory with realized outcomes, enabling within-episode strategy adaptation.

contributions.purpose: 新闻感知调节流动性与风险
contributions.mechanism: EnhancedLLMNewsAnalyzer把结构化新闻转成情绪/置信/风险,驱动LLM交易与做市agent
contributions.evaluation: 定性:注入4条合成新闻,仅LLMON感知并传导到价格(图2)
contributions.source_quote: only the LLMON configuration consistently perceived these injections and propagated their effects into the simulated price dynamics.

contributions.mechanism: 回放NASDAQ ITCH(经LOBSTER),校准异构背景agent,对齐每秒时钟算price_error_bps
contributions.evaluation: 定性:LLMON微结构(价差/波动/深度)更贴近历史(仅可视化overlay,未报price_error_bps数值)
contributions.source_quote: our LLM-enhanced system accurately reproduces key market microstructure phenomena, including price discovery and trade intensity.

self_declared_provenance.quote: We augment the well-established ABIDES simulator with a novel Brain-Memory Architecture.

notes: 工程性扩展ABIDES(有具名源文件,系统描述较实)。数据红旗:(1)结果全定性——图1-5均无坐标数值/表格,明确定义了price_error_bps公式却从未报告其值;(2)数据源自相矛盾:正文结果反复称'AMZN, June 21, 2012',但§3.6数据管线生成的CSV命名为'AAPL_2012-06-21...csv'(AMZN与AAPL冲突);(3)样本n=1(单日单股);(4)Paper Checklist对'误差棒/统计显著性/compute'全答Yes并只写'yes,it does.',但论文无任何误差棒、统计检验或compute信息——声称与呈现严重不符;checklist潦草(拼写'collusion'代conclusion,假设项[A]答'entirely unique to humans')。
